breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained a contradiction by specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Strang splitting' for the time integration. The ground truth resolves this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction entirely. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead merged the two contradictory instructions into the phrase 'Implement the time integration using Strang splitting with explicit forward Euler', which is incorrect as the specified splitting method does not use Forward Euler.
